name: soak
description: Manage soak testing lifecycle: abort an active soak and roll back to a prior version.
author: nself

actions.abort: Abort a running soak and roll back to a prior version

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables. `nself plugin install soak` must place the built nself-soak binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-soak, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself soak <args>` with stdio inherited. It shells out to `nself deploy rollback <env>` for the actual rollback. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/soak_abort.go and cli/internal/soak/ under CLI-R11.
